acceptance_criteria.statement: System emits +10 minute reminder events and accepts +15 minute no-show flag only when no accepted future
Successful no-show adjudication updates both booking and task to `NO_SHOW` in one transaction and appends
Reschedule request/accept/decline/expiry actions are immutable timeline events; accepted reschedule updates
Chat-only schedule mentions do not alter policy timers; no-show and late-cancel checks always use latest accepted
No-show and reschedule state-changing endpoints are idempotent on duplicate retries.
